title: Wishes and regrets: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ a car. I have to take the bus every day.
items.explanationEs: Deseo sobre el presente (no tengo coche): wish + pasado, had.

items.prompt: I'm so tired. I wish I ___ to bed earlier last night.
items.explanationEs: Arrepentimiento del pasado (last night): wish + had + participio.

items.statement: I hope you have a great birthday.
items.explanationEs: Algo posible y bueno: hope + presente.

items.statement: I wish it will be sunny tomorrow.
items.explanationEs: Algo posible en el futuro va con hope: I hope it's sunny tomorrow.

answers: I should have listened to you.
items.explanationEs: Lo que habría sido correcto: should have + participio (listened).

answers: She wishes she could play the piano.
items.explanationEs: Deseo sobre el presente: can da un paso atrás, could.
